items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I never got a chance to meet Louis personally, but I heard him the night of the affair.

ctx.x: No, no. Banjo player. Banjo player. There were two Barnes's down there. But I think this fella's name was Barnes too. Isaac Barnes, I believe. That was in the Barnes that Louis went to. I believe. And during this winter down there while I was there, they advertised that this fella, another Barnes there who all tried to have a man around, he sent to New Orleans and brought Louis up there to play with him. I never got a chance to meet Louis personally, but I heard him the night of the affair. We had an engagement…
Was the New Orleans style you felt different? Was that the New Orleans influence?
